subject: Colloquium: "Adversarial Robustness in Biometric Systems" - Fri Nov 14
body:
Dear {{firstName}},
The Bellini College of Computing, Cybersecurity, and AI invites you to this week's research colloquium. Light refreshments will be served, and graduate students are strongly encouraged to attend.
Title:Adversarial Robustness in Biometric Systems
Speaker:Dr. Lena Ortiz, Georgia Tech
When:Friday, Nov 14, 2:00 - 3:00 PM
Where:ENB 118 (Tampa campus)
No RSVP is required. A recording will be shared with the department afterward for those who cannot attend in person.
Best regards,
Bellini College Events Committee
University of South Florida
